description:
Dynamic Duplicate Portrait Replacer

Less clone-face. More sector flavor. No faction identity takeover.

Current Version:

0.3.0

Starsector Version:

0.98a-RC8

Author:

Computica

Mod Type:

Utility / Portrait QoL

Dependencies:

None required

Optional Support:

LunaLib, Version Checker

DOWNLOAD CURRENT BUILD

GitHub Repository

|

Changelog

What is this?

Dynamic Duplicate Portrait Replacer

is a lightweight Starsector utility mod that helps reduce repeated generated officer portraits in heavily modded games.

Instead of completely taking over portrait generation, the mod follows a more conservative approach: it preserves the first use of a vanilla-style portrait, then only considers later duplicate uses for replacement. The goal is simple: keep the sector feeling familiar while cutting down on the “why are there five copies of this officer?” problem.

This is especially useful for large modlists where generated officers start repeating the same vanilla portraits across multiple markets, fleets, and factions.

Main Features

Dynamically replaces duplicate generated officer portraits.Preserves vanilla-style portraits until they begin repeating.Uses organized portrait pools instead of random global replacement.Supports faction-aware and gender-aware portrait pools.Bundled portraits appear in the new-game character portrait picker.Allows unmapped mod factions to participate by default.Includes a recommended blacklist to protect factions with strong portrait identities.Supports extra local blacklist overrides through LunaLib.Includes Version Checker support.

Why use it?

Starsector’s officer system can start looking repetitive once your campaign grows, especially with a large modlist. This mod is meant to be a “quiet improvement” rather than a giant visual overhaul.

It does

not

try to overwrite every portrait in the game. It focuses on duplicates, respects faction identity, and gives players/modders control over how aggressive the replacement behavior should be.

In short:

Vanilla feel preserved. Duplicate faces reduced. Mod factions respected.

Configuration

LunaLib users can configure the main behavior in-game.

Without LunaLib, settings can be edited manually here:

Code

data/config/dynamic_portraits/settings.json

Current configurable behavior includes:

Whether only duplicate vanilla portraits are replaced.Whether unmapped factions are protected or allowed to participate.Replacement chance values by role.Faction-to-role portrait mappings.Faction blacklist protection.Duplicate source behavior.

For adding support to another faction, add the faction ID to the faction role map and create a matching portrait role folder under:

Code

graphics/portraits

Recommended Blacklist Philosophy

Some mod factions have very distinctive visual identities and should not have their officer portraits casually replaced. Dynamic Duplicate Portrait Replacer includes a recommended blacklist for these cases.

LunaLib keeps the recommended blacklist behind a toggle and also provides a short field for adding your own extra faction IDs locally.

This keeps the mod flexible: ordinary factions can participate, while factions with strong custom portrait sets can stay protected.

Current Changelog Highlight

## 0.2.8

- Checks ship captains assigned directly to fleet members when the player opens a fleet interaction.

- Fixes mod and special fleets whose visible captains were not registered in the fleet officer list.

## 0.2.7

- Adds four Valkyrian-style female portraits to the mercenary replacement pool.

- Registers the new portraits for both Dynamic Portraits replacement and player new-game portrait selection.

## 0.2.6

- Fixes Starsector script-sandbox compatibility by loading portrait pools from registered JSON data instead of scanning the filesystem.

- Reads LunaLib settings through the normal LunaLib API instead of blocked reflection.

## 0.2.5

- Replaces the paused polling script with an event-driven campaign listener.

- Cleans portraits when the player opens an interaction dialog, comm screen target, or market, instead of scanning repeatedly while menus are open.

## 0.2.4

- Reduces background scan cost by processing one current-location fleet and market slice per tick instead of sweeping the whole location.

- Prioritizes the active interaction target so open market and patrol dialogs are still cleaned promptly while paused.

## 0.2.3

- Simplifies mod-faction cleanup: non-blacklisted unmapped factions are cleaned directly instead of using vanilla first-duplicate preservation.

- Loosens portrait eligibility for mod faction portrait paths outside the normal `graphics/portraits` layout.

- Fixes LunaLib numeric setting reads when values are returned as a generic number type.

## 0.2.2

- Runs duplicate cleanup while paused so newly opened comm directories and interaction screens can be cleaned up.

- Prioritizes markets in the player's current location before falling back to the broader market scan.

- Shortens the scan interval and logs the first few replacements to make faction-specific cleanup easier to verify.

## 0.2.1

- Adds a versioned cleanup pass so existing saves can revisit duplicate portraits that older settings already marked as processed.

- Scans market administrators, market people, and comm-directory entries in addition to fleets.

- Prevents already-assigned Dynamic Portraits images from being re-rolled by later cleanup passes.

Previous versions added new-game portrait picker support, LunaLib blacklist controls, duplicate-generated-officer replacement, faction/gender portrait pools, and Version Checker support.

Main Features

  • Dynamically replaces duplicate generated officer portraits.
  • Preserves vanilla-style portraits until they begin repeating.
  • Uses organized portrait pools instead of random global replacement.
  • Supports faction-aware and gender-aware portrait pools.
  • Bundled portraits appear in the new-game character portrait picker.
  • Allows unmapped mod factions to participate by default.
  • Includes a recommended blacklist to protect factions with strong portrait identities.
  • Supports extra local blacklist overrides through LunaLib.
  • Includes Version Checker support.


Why use it?

Starsector’s officer system can start looking repetitive once your campaign grows, especially with a large modlist. This mod is meant to be a “quiet improvement” rather than a giant visual overhaul.

It does not try to overwrite every portrait in the game. It focuses on duplicates, respects faction identity, and gives players/modders control over how aggressive the replacement behavior should be.

In short:

Vanilla feel preserved. Duplicate faces reduced. Mod factions respected.

Configuration

LunaLib users can configure the main behavior in-game.

Without LunaLib, settings can be edited manually here:

Code
data/config/dynamic_portraits/settings.json

Current configurable behavior includes:

  • Whether only duplicate vanilla portraits are replaced.
  • Whether unmapped factions are protected or allowed to participate.
  • Replacement chance values by role.
  • Faction-to-role portrait mappings.
  • Faction blacklist protection.
  • Duplicate source behavior.

For adding support to another faction, add the faction ID to the faction role map and create a matching portrait role folder under:

graphics/portraits

This keeps the mod flexible: ordinary factions can participate, while factions with strong custom portrait sets can stay protected.
